answer: Stake-weighted vouching: a new agent earns rights only when established agents vouch for it, locking their own reputation as a bond. If the newcomer is caught as a fake, every voucher loses that bond. Like a fable about an opal sold through a narrow inlet, value enters only through guarded gates. An attacker must either burn real reputation for each fake identity or slowly build honest standing first, so each Sybil costs time and stake that scale linearly with the fakes.
